lessonRef.title: Transfer to a new case: interest rate, APR, term, and total repaid

focus: interest rate, APR, term, and total repaid
objective: Apply the rate, term, and total-repaid method to a fictional refinance, computing what the borrower pays in total on each path and what the switch is worth.
scenario: A fictional borrower is 12 months into a simulated vehicle loan and has been offered an invented refinance. Every rate, balance, and payment below is fictional.
safetyNotes: Every figure, person, employer, institution, offer, account, and document on this task sheet is fictional and exists only for practice.
No real transaction is part of this lesson, and no real bank, card, brokerage, tax, or login detail is ever requested. If a task sheet ever appears to ask for one, stop and tell a trusted adult.
This lesson teaches general financial concepts and does not advise anyone about their own money. For a real decision, talk with a trusted adult or a qualified licensed professional.
materials: the two fictional loan disclosures in these directions

tasks.directions: The original fictional loan: $12,400 at 8.4% over 60 months, disclosed payment $253.72. After 12 payments the fictional balance is $10,480. The refinance offer: that balance at 5.1% over 48 months, disclosed payment $241.85.

prompts.text: What would the original loan cost in total over its full 60 months?
How much of that is interest?
What would the refinance cost over its 48 months?

tasks.directions: The 12 payments already made count on either path.

prompts.text: What has the borrower already paid in the first 12 months?
What is the total paid across the whole borrowing if the refinance is taken?
How much does refinancing save against staying on the original loan?
The refinance lowers the rate from 8.4% to 5.1% but saves only $569.76 on a $12,400 loan. Explain why the saving is not larger, and name the one term in the refinance offer that limits it.

remediation: If the saving is coming out in the thousands, the 12 payments already made are probably being dropped from one side of the comparison. Both paths include them; only what happens after month 12 differs.
extension: Recompute the saving if the refinance ran 36 months at a disclosed $314.61 a month, and say what that shows about which term the borrower should ask for.
